test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A statement followed by two possible underlying assumptions I and II are given. Read all the information carefully, and decide which of the assumptions can be inferred from the given statements.

statement:<

options.text: Neither I nor ॥ can be inferred.
Both I and II can be inferred.

solution:
__**Given statement**__:

"If we advertise our play in all the local newspapers before the end of this week, we will sell more tickets for our play this weekend." a drama director in city D

__**Assumptions**__:

I. The newspaper companies in City D take less than a week to finalize the ads, and publish them → The statement implies that, by advertising the play, more tickets will be sold before weekend which can also be said as the newspaper companies takes less time to publish ads so the assumption is true.

II. Not many people in city D like to watch Drama → There is no evidence in the given statement that suggests the likes or dislikes of the people in city D so it will be wrong to support this assumptions thus the assumption cannot be inferred.

So **only ****I can be inferred.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 2)**
